title: About Petalnex
content: Petalnex Pvt. Ltd. is an AI automation training and consulting company founded in 2023. The company specializes in workflow automation using tools like n8n, AI agent design, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. Petalnex runs a flagship 'AI Automation Internship' program that trains students through a structured day-by-day curriculum culminating in real-world projects.

title: Mission Statement
content: Petalnex's mission is to make AI automation skills accessible to students and working professionals by combining hands-on projects with mentor-led guidance, so learners can build production-ready automations, not just toy demos.

title: Office Locations
content: Petalnex's headquarters is in Bengaluru, India, with a secondary support office in Pune. The company operates fully remote for internship delivery, with all sessions conducted online.

title: AI Automation Internship Overview
content: The AI Automation Internship is a 4-week, 24-working-day intensive program. Each week focuses on a theme: Week 1 covers n8n fundamentals, Week 2 covers integrations and APIs, Week 3 covers AI agents and prompt engineering, and Week 4 covers RAG systems and capstone projects.

title: Weekly Assignments
content: Every day of the internship includes a practical assignment that must be submitted before the next day's session. Day 24, the final assignment, requires interns to build a complete RAG/agent assistant over real company knowledge, including a vector database, retrieval pipeline, and generation step.

title: Certification Criteria
content: Interns receive a certificate of completion only if they submit all 24 daily assignments and pass the final capstone review. The capstone review checks that the workflow JSON runs end-to-end, the knowledge base has at least 20 entries, and the intern can demo the assistant live in 2-5 minutes.

title: Mentor Support
content: Each cohort of interns is assigned a dedicated mentor who reviews daily submissions and hosts two live doubt-clearing sessions per week. Mentors respond to queries on the internal Slack workspace within 24 hours on working days.

title: Internship Duration and Schedule
content: The internship runs Monday to Friday, with daily live sessions from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM IST, followed by self-paced project work. Interns are expected to spend approximately 4-6 hours per day on the program.

title: Automation Consulting Service
content: Beyond training, Petalnex offers paid automation consulting for small and mid-sized businesses, building custom n8n workflows for lead generation, customer support automation, and internal reporting dashboards.

title: Managed n8n Hosting
content: Petalnex provides managed n8n hosting for clients who do not want to self-host. This includes daily backups, uptime monitoring, and priority email support, billed monthly per workflow environment.

title: Internship Fee
content: The AI Automation Internship costs INR 12,999 for the standard track and INR 18,999 for the premium track, which includes 1:1 mentor calls and a guaranteed project portfolio review. Early-bird enrollment offers a 15% discount if paid at least 2 weeks before the cohort start date.

title: Consulting Rates
content: Automation consulting engagements are billed at INR 2,500 per hour, or as fixed-price project quotes for well-defined scopes. A minimum engagement of 10 hours applies to all new consulting clients.

title: Managed Hosting Plans
content: Managed n8n hosting starts at INR 3,999 per month for a single workflow environment with up to 5,000 executions, and scales to INR 9,999 per month for unlimited workflows with priority support.

title: Refund Policy
content: Petalnex offers a full refund on internship fees if requested within 3 days of cohort start, provided the intern has not accessed more than 2 days of course content. No refunds are issued after the first week of the cohort.

title: Attendance Policy
content: Interns must maintain at least 80% attendance in live sessions to remain eligible for the completion certificate. Interns who miss a live session can watch the recording but must still submit that day's assignment on time.

title: Late Submission Policy
content: Assignments submitted up to 24 hours late incur no penalty. Submissions between 24 and 72 hours late are accepted with a 10% score deduction. Submissions beyond 72 hours late are not accepted unless an extension was pre-approved by the mentor.

title: Code of Conduct
content: Interns are expected to maintain professional conduct in all Slack channels and live sessions. Plagiarized assignment submissions, including uncredited AI-generated work presented as original analysis, may result in disqualification from the certification track.

title: Support Channels
content: Interns can reach support through the #help-desk Slack channel, email at support@petalnex.example, or the in-portal ticketing system. General support queries are answered within 1 business day.

title: Technical Issue Escalation
content: For urgent technical issues that block coursework, such as broken sandbox environments, interns should mark their ticket as 'Urgent' in the support portal, which triggers a response within 4 hours during business hours.

title: Business Hours
content: Petalnex support and admin teams operate Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST. The support desk is closed on Indian public holidays, with a holiday calendar published at the start of each year.

title: Tools Covered in the Internship
content: The curriculum covers n8n as the core automation platform, along with integrations for Google Sheets, Slack, Telegram, Supabase, Pinecone, OpenAI, and Google Gemini for building AI-powered workflows and RAG assistants.

title: Capstone Project Requirements
content: The Week 4 capstone project requires interns to build a Company Knowledge AI Assistant: a RAG pipeline that ingests at least 20 knowledge entries into a vector database and answers user questions with retrieval-grounded, AI-generated responses, including a fallback for unanswerable questions.
